_about: Voter-footprint SEIFA per federal booth: vote-weighted mean SEIFA scores over the SA1s where the booth's VOTERS live (AEC 'Votes by SA1' roll mark-off x results product — AEC-flagged indicative, rounded), the footprint complement to the venue-proxy store booth-seifa-YYYY.json (SA1 of the premises). Votes SA1s are ASGS Ed2. Scores are SEIFA 2021: each 2016 SA1's votes are redistributed over SA1_CODE21 targets by the ABS CG_SA1_2016_SA1_2021 correspondence (RATIO_FROM_TO shares). Per-index ABS suppression: each index weights over its own covered votes (cov). Sentinel …9999 no-address SA1s are vote-counted but score-excluded. pp_id 0 rows are division declaration cohorts (Postal/Pre-Poll/Absent/Provisional), emitted per division, not per booth. Booths the votes file never lists (unused PPVCs, cancelled mobile teams) carry votes:null and note:noVotesRows.
